rows.label: Zombie

rows.hook: is a grunge-tinged rock anthem with a wailing, distorted chorus and a repeated "in your head" refrain

rows.label: We Are the World
rows.hook: was recorded by dozens of famous singers in one night to raise money for famine relief

rows.label: Mr. Brightside
rows.hook: is a jealousy-fuelled rock anthem with a driving guitar riff that still fills dance floors

rows.label: Bitter Sweet Symphony
rows.hook: is built on a looped string sample and paired with a video of a man striding down a pavement

rows.label: Gangnam Style
rows.hook: was the first video to pass a billion YouTube views, thanks to its invisible-horse dance

rows.label: Creep
rows.description: song written and composed by Radiohead
rows.hook: features a self-loathing narrator and a loud guitar crunch before each chorus

rows.label: Money for Nothing
rows.hook: has a guest vocal from Sting and a sneering narrator who wants his music on television

rows.label: Wake Me Up When September Ends
rows.hook: is a mournful rock ballad about losing a father, building from a soft acoustic start

rows.label: Seven Nation Army
rows.hook: is built on a bass-sounding guitar riff that fans chant in sports stadiums worldwide

rows.label: We Didn't Start the Fire
rows.description: 1989 list song and single by Billy Joel
rows.hook: rattles off a rapid list of headlines, people and events from decades of history

rows.label: Since U Been Gone
rows.hook: is a pop-rock breakup anthem with a huge chorus, sung by the first American Idol winner

rows.label: Can't Get You Out of My Head
rows.hook: has a catchy la-la-la hook and a disco-flavoured video with a glittering white jumpsuit

rows.label: Another Day in Paradise
rows.hook: is a soft-rock song about homelessness, sung by a drummer who became a solo star

rows.label: Call Me Maybe
rows.hook: is a bubbly pop song about handing a phone number to a crush, boosted by a viral video

rows.label: Paint It Black
rows.hook: opens with a sitar and sings of a world turned dark after a loss

rows.label: Every Breath You Take
rows.hook: sounds like a love song but has a possessive narrator who keeps watching someone

rows.label: Space Oddity
rows.hook: tells of an astronaut named Major Tom drifting away from ground control

rows.label: Blinding Lights
rows.hook: is a retro synth-pop smash that dominated streaming charts for years

rows.label: Shape of You
rows.hook: is a tropical-house hit about a romance that begins in a bar, with a marimba-style hook

rows.label: Flowers
rows.hook: is a self-love anthem about treating yourself well after a breakup

rows.label: Nothing Compares 2 U
rows.description: song by Prince, popularized by a 1990 cover performed by Sinéad O'Connor

rows.label: Free Bird
rows.hook: ends with a famously long guitar solo that fans shout requests for at concerts

rows.label: Another One Bites the Dust

rows.label: The Fox
rows.description: 2013 electronic dance novelty song and viral video by Norwegian comedy duo Ylvis

rows.label: What Is Love
rows.hook: is a Eurodance staple, famously head-bobbed to in a Saturday Night Live sketch

rows.label: Sk8er Boi

rows.label: Friday
rows.hook: was a viral video mocked online for lyrics about picking which seat to take in a car

rows.label: Toxic
rows.hook: is a dance-pop hit with a twisting string hook and a secret-agent-style video

rows.label: Happy
rows.hook: is a clap-along feel-good hit from an animated film about yellow minions

rows.label: Lose Yourself
rows.hook: is a rap about seizing one shot, from a film about a Detroit battle rapper

rows.label: Enjoy the Silence

rows.label: Enter Sandman

rows.label: Good Vibrations

rows.label: Party in the U.S.A.

rows.label: Yellow
rows.hook: is a soft-rock ballad about stars, with a video of a singer walking along a rainy beach

rows.label: Con te partirò
rows.hook: is an Italian power ballad that became a famous duet with an English soprano

rows.label: In the End
rows.hook: starts with a piano riff and trades rapped verses with sung choruses about effort that goes nowhere

rows.label: Dream On
rows.hook: is a rock ballad that starts with a keyboard and builds to a famous screeching scream

rows.label: Thunderstruck
rows.hook: opens with a rapid, finger-tapped guitar riff and chanting voices

rows.label: La Isla Bonita

rows.hook: is an electronic hit with a mournful vocal, made by a hooded producer

rows.label: Espresso
rows.hook: is a cheeky summer pop hit comparing the singer's effect on someone to a caffeine jolt

rows.label: Chop Suey!
rows.hook: switches between frantic verses and a soaring operatic chorus

rows.label: Song 2
rows.hook: is famous for its "woo-hoo" shout and constant use in sports arenas

rows.label: Tik Tok
rows.hook: is a party-all-night anthem with a talk-sung, auto-tuned delivery

rows.label: Irreplaceable
rows.hook: tells an unfaithful partner to leave, with a line about boxes to the left

rows.label: Fireflies
rows.description: 2009 song by Owl City from Ocean Eyes
rows.hook: is a dreamy synth-pop track about sleeplessness and glowing insects
